title: Plague's End
start: Speak to Arianwyn in eastern Lletya.

items.t: A full set of Mourner outfit (gas mask, mourner boots, mourner cloak, mourner gloves, mourner top and mourner trousers)
Plant cure or runes to cast Cure Plant (requires access to the Lunar Spells and 66 Magic)
1 gold, green, crimson and blue charm

recommended.t: A crystal teleport seed or two; possibly runes for the NPC Contact spell if you're only using one seed, so that Eluned may remotely recharge your teleport seed
Antipoison potions or an anti-poison totem, which should be worn whilst traversing the woodlands
Wearing the Tirannwn quiver 2 prevents tripwires from dealing damage and applying poison
3200 coins (without reductions) for chartering a ship to Port Tyras
Tirannwn quiver for extra damage against mourners
Tirannwn quiver 1 provides free teleports to Lletya and Eluned
Tirannwn quiver 2 additionally provides free teleports to Tyras Camp
Ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim or the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Daemonheim Dig Site.
Dramen staff or A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift completed to skip most of the Poison Waste by teleporting with fairy Ring code DLR.

kills.t: 3 Trahaearn automatons (level 70; all three are fought at once and each of them use a different style of the Combat Triangle)
Multiple shadows and greater shadows (up to level 107)
Dark Lord (level 107; five times and you may restock between each kill)

rewards.t: Experience in 10 skills (if you lose any of the reward lamps for any reason, you will not be able to re-obtain them):
Access to the city of Prifddinas
The Trahaearn exoskeleton set, which inherits the benefits of the black ibis outfit if previously owned, and also provides a set bonus.
Access to the Prifddinas undercity (the entrance to which can be found at the east Prifddinas gate, can also be accessed through the Temple of Light)
Ability to use the herringbone light and dark floor styles in a player-owned house
Access to the Mourner headquarter entrance in West Ardougne without the need for mourner gear

steps.t: Talk to Arianwyn in Lletya. [Chat: 1 Let's go! › Accept › 1 I have the Mourner disguise with me. › 1 I'm ready to teleport.]
Enter western door.
Open northern door. [Chat: 3 We thought we saw a mouse. › 2 It might get into the food stores. › 1 We knew you were busy, so we dealt with it.]
Head to the north-western room.
Talk to a Mourner.
Talk to Iestin Edern. [Chat: 2 The captain wants you to hurry.]
Climb up the nearby stairs (north wall).
Talk to the Mayor of Prifddinas in the house north of the camp. [Chat: 2 I've got a report from Iestin Edern.]
Talk to the Mourner at the bridge, south of the camp. [Chat: 1 The mayor wants you to distribute the food to the crowd.]
Return to the Mayor. [Chat: 1 The guards are distributing it to the crowd!]
Take Iorwerth master plan from the desk.
Head south-east back downstairs and talk to Iestin Edern. [Chat: 1 I have a document with Lord Iorwerth's plans here. › 3 How can we stop him?]
Talk to Councillor Halgrive outside the East Ardougne church (south west of lodestone), located just west of the main square. [Chat: 1 I need to show you this document.]

Talk to Bravek in the upper floor of Civic Office of West Ardougne. [Chat: 1 I need to show you this document. › 2 If you suspected, why didn't you do anything? › 2 We need to overthrow the Mourners.]
Unequip 1 mourner piece. The people won't speak to you with a full set of mourner outfit equipped.
Talk to the 6 people on the list:

sub.t: Ted or Martha Rehnison - In a building north of the civic office. [Chat: 1 I need your help to overthrow the Mourners.]
Jethick - On the eastern side of the large paved area outside the civic office. [Chat: 1 We would if we tore down the city's walls. Join my revolution!]
Nurse Sarah - In a building south-west of the church. [Chat: 1 I'd feel better if you joined my revolution.]
Carla - In an open area, north of the graveyard to the west of the church. [Chat: 1 Join my revolution and avenge your son.]
Koftik - Entrance to the Underground Pass. [Chat: 1 I want to help you overthrow the Mourners.]

Elena - Found in the house just west of the log balance in the northern part of East Ardougne (from the lodestone run south-west and then take log balance to cross the river). [Chat: 1 Yes - and it's time to stop them.]

steps.t: Go to the church in West Ardougne.
Talk to any of the 6 NPCs at the church (not the priest). [Chat: 1 Yes - I'll explain everything, and then we'll strike! › 5 Enough talk - it's time to strike!]
Head to the Mourner Headquarters (north-east).
Kick down door and kill the mourners. (If door is not closed, transport away and come back. No mourner gear needed.)
Open trapdoor in north-west corner and kill the mourners.
Defeat then talk to Head Mourner. [Chat: 1 I have some questions. › 2 How were you going to summon the Dark Lord? › 3 Enough questions. › Any]
Talk to Elena with one free inventory space.
Go up to the floor 2 and replace the Mourners standard.
Head to the entrance of Ardougne Castle.
Talk to Sir Edmond at the entrance. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Head upstairs, talk to King Lathas.
Kill Sir Hugo.
Talk to King Lathas. [Chat: 3 You need to pay with your death.]
Talk to Sir Edmond.
Return to Lletya, switch back into full mourner's gear and talk to Arianwyn to go back to the undercity. [Chat: 1 I'm ready to teleport.]
Talk to Iestin Edern. [Chat: 3 Okay - what do I do now? › 2 Go on... › 1 Yes - teleport me to Lletya now.]
Talk to Gwir, just north. [Chat: 1 I need to find the Elders of Prifddinas.]
If you don't have 3 free inventory spaces, use the bank in the building
Search a bookcase for The Lost Elders book. [Chat: 1 The Lost Elders]
Read the book.
Talk to Gwir for 2 items. [Chat: 1 I need to find the Elders of Prifddinas. › 4 Lord Amlodd. › 5 More... › 2 Lady Meilyr. › 5 That's all.]
The blue symbols you need to inspect are on the walls, near the floor, in Lletya. Ground level:

sub.t: Ranging shop (south west building), along western wall
Southern building, south wall.
Bank, east wall, south of the table.

steps.t: Upper level:

sub.t: Up the central stairs, outside altar room, north wall
Up the clothing store stairs, west wall.

steps.t: Head to the centre of Lletya and build the statue hotspot.
Climb upstairs.
Speak to Kelyn. [Chat: 4 It's time. I'm gathering the clan leaders.]
Make your way to the Well of Voyage:

sub.t: Exit Lletya, pass tree (north-west).
Step-over tripwire (west).
Enter dense forest (west).
Jump leaves (north).
Head east until you find a cave entrance and enter it.

steps.t: Head east, mine cracked wall (south of the well).
Enter tunnel.
Kill 3 level 70 automatons (each automaton uses a different side of the combat triangle).
Wake Lady Trahaearn. [Chat: 1 Repair the exoskeleton. › 3 It's time. I'm gathering the clan leaders.]
Go north back into the room where you mined the wall.
Use the Amlodd Charm on the obelisk to the north-west. [Chat: 1 Create the Amlodd pouch.]
Summon Amlodd pouch. [Chat: 1 Are you my summoned creature now? Can I command you? › 3 It's time. I'm gathering the clan leaders.]
Home teleport to Tirannwn Lodestone.
Pick a blue mushroom (you must have the Meilyr potion recipe in order to pick the mushrooms).
Enter Dense Forest (west of Tirannwn Lodestone).
Pick a red mushroom (these mushrooms are for later. Might appear very light shade of red).
Step over trip-wire (north-west).
Enter dense forest two times (north - do not pass the third one).
Chop down tree (east).
Inspect tree (west).
Use plant cure on the tree.
Talk to Lord Crwys. [Chat: 4 It's time. I'm gathering the clan leaders.]
Make your way to the Poison Waste:

sub.t: Take Fairy ring code DLR to the small island in the swamp. Head west once arriving onto the island via fairy ring.
Alternatively, go to Lletya:
Exit Lletya, pass tree (north-west).
Head far south to the large swamp area, past the magic trees.

steps.t: Jump the small rocks to each island, going west, referencing the map captioned right (read map from right to left).
Talk to Elf Hermit. [Chat: 2 I seek the wisdom of Seren. › 2 Seren's faithfulness to the elves. › 1 The symmetry of crystals. › 3 I don't know. › 4 It's time. I'm gathering the clan leaders.]
Grind your red and blue Isafdar mushrooms.
Use on super defence (3) potion.
Teleport to Daemonheim by using ring of kinship or taking the ferry by talking to Bryll Thoksdottir in Taverley.
Drink Meilyr potion in the Dungeoneering lobby at Daemonheim.
Enter the portal that appears on the west side.
Talk to Lady Meilyr. [Chat: 4 It's time. I'm gathering the clan leaders.]
Return to Lletya.
Talk to Arianwyn. [Chat: 1 I'm ready to teleport.]
Talk to Iestin Edern. [Chat: 3 That's all for now.]
Travel to Tyras Camp (west of Tirannwn lodestone) or charter ship to Tyras Camp via Port Sarim.
Talk to General Hining. [Chat: 4 The time has come to face the darkness.]
Prepare for combat (fire-based spells preferred).
Return to Lletya.
Talk to Arianwyn. [Chat: 1 I'm ready to teleport.]
Talk to Iestin Edern.
Enter the Grand Library and walk west to the puzzle. [Chat: 2 Okay, what do I do now?]
Talk to Lord Crwys to begin stage 1.
Direct light into the centre (place/rotate mirrors as needed).
Use Protect/Deflect Magic and keep moving when Dark Lord is alive. You can either kill the enemies between puzzles or tank their hits.

sub.t: Each puzzle completed saves, so you can leave for more food and return between puzzles/fights.

steps.t: After directing the beam into the Crwys Crystal, there will be some dialogue.
Quest complete!
Recommended: exit the Grand Library and speak to Arianwyn to teleport to the entrance of Prifddinas, or walk there yourself. After a skippable cutscene, the city of Prifddinas will be unlocked.
p: The solution to the Cadarn puzzle
Fighting the Dark Lord between one of the puzzles
As Prifddinas is restored, the Dark Lord is finally defeated
The camp inside Prifddinas, under the control of the Iorwerths
Building the statue of Lady Ithell
Fighting the automatons guarding Lady Trahaearn
